bugs.error_message: PowerShell test handling did not surface the expected JSON body for a 400 validation response.
bugs.root_cause: Invoke-RestMethod exposes a generic WebException message for non-2xx responses.
bugs.fix: The API correctly returned HTTP 400; use an HTTP client that captures the response body when asserting the message.

bugs.error_message: node --check could not find mock-server.mjs from the client working directory.
bugs.root_cause: The server syntax check used the client workdir.
bugs.fix: Run the check from the server directory.

bugs.error_message: apply_patch rejected a combined delete-and-add operation on RiskTreatment.jsx.
bugs.root_cause: The patch tool does not allow multiple operations on the same file in one patch.
bugs.fix: Delete and add the file in separate patches.

bugs.error_message: Project paths were resolved relative to the client directory instead of the workspace root.
bugs.root_cause: Incorrect relative path used after changing the command working directory.
bugs.fix: Use paths relative to the selected workdir, or absolute workspace paths.

bugs.error_message: Vite could not resolve client/vite.config.js and reported an access-denied directory read during build.
bugs.root_cause: The workspace file sandbox prevented Vite/esbuild from traversing directories while loading its local configuration.
bugs.fix: Run the Vite build with the required sandbox escalation; the build then completed successfully.

bugs.error_message: vite is not recognized as an internal or external command.
bugs.root_cause: The main client has no installed node_modules dependencies.
bugs.fix: Run npm.cmd install in the client directory before building or serving it.

bugs.error_message: npm.ps1 cannot be loaded because running scripts is disabled on this system.
bugs.root_cause: PowerShell execution policy blocks the npm PowerShell shim.

bugs.error_message: Risk treatments could be marked complete solely by reaching 100% progress, which bypassed effectiveness evidence and closure gates.
bugs.root_cause: The progress patch endpoint set status to COMPLETED whenever progress reached 100 without validating independent review or closure conditions.
bugs.fix: Require evidence-backed effectiveness review before a treatment can be marked complete, and keep workflow state distinct from overdue_flag and escalation metadata.

bugs.error_message: The treatment UI crashed because browser prompt() is not supported in the shared app runtime.
bugs.root_cause: Approval, evidence, and review actions called window.prompt() directly from React click handlers.
bugs.fix: Replace prompt-based inputs with modal dialogs and explicit form validation for decision comments, evidence references, and effectiveness review scores.

bugs.error_message: Treatment progress could not reach 100% because the endpoint required an effectiveness review, while effectiveness review was only available for COMPLETED treatments.
bugs.root_cause: Implementation completion and independent effectiveness validation were enforced in the wrong order.
bugs.fix: Allow progress 100% to transition to COMPLETED, then require evidence and an independent non-owner review before closure monitoring; also corrected overdue workflow status normalization and GovernanceEngine import.

bugs.error_message: npm test exits with code 1 because no client test files are present.
bugs.root_cause: The configured Vitest include pattern has no matching test files in the client workspace.
bugs.fix: No test tooling changes made; rely on the successful Vite production build and Node syntax checks for this change.

bugs.error_message: Executive report dashboard showed zero compliance, framework coverage, and control effectiveness despite populated controls.
bugs.root_cause: dashboardSummary read a nonexistent implementationStatus field and derived effectiveness from an empty risk-control link collection instead of the populated control records.
bugs.fix: Calculate implementation from control status/progress, calculate effectiveness from control effectiveness scores, expose the shared effectiveness percentage, and use the same snapshot in the frontend radar and platform executive exports.

bugs.error_message: Audit engagement exports serialized the lead auditor object as [object Object].
bugs.root_cause: The report mapped the nested leadAuditor object directly instead of selecting its display name.
bugs.fix: Map leadAuditor.fullName, then username, before rendering XLSX/PDF/CSV.

bugs.error_message: npm run build failed with Missing script because the command ran outside the frontend project directory.
bugs.root_cause: The validation shell starts in the workspace root rather than the application directory.
bugs.fix: Rerun the existing build script with an explicit Set-Location to the frontend project.

bugs.error_message: The frontend build failed because it was run from the repository wrapper instead of the client directory; router entry was not found.
bugs.root_cause: The application has separate server and client directories with the Vite package manifest under client.
bugs.fix: Run the existing frontend build from the client directory.
